familiar-face.name: Familiar Face
familiar-face.effect:
Whenever a Familiar Face enters your armoury, I Distort. / 
At your recovery, return me to my owners hand.

heliana-dictator-of-recollection.name: Heliana, Dictator of Recollection
heliana-dictator-of-recollection.effect: Brandish: For each Hazed Memory your opponent wields, Shatter an armament. For the rest of the game, players cannot play cards with the same name as armaments shattered this way.

madness-clairvoyant.name: Madness Clairvoyant
madness-clairvoyant.effect: Test 2 Resolve, Exhaust: Your opponent creates a Hazed Memory. Crescent Moon: Your opponent creates 2 instead.

memory-of-relief.name: Memory of Relief
memory-of-relief.effect:
At your recovery, restore 2 health. If your condition worsens, I Distort. / 
At your recovery deal 1 damage to all acolytes and you lose 1 health.

pora-mind-s-guardian.name: Pora, Mind's Guardian
pora-mind-s-guardian.effect: Whenever an armament you wield would Distort, you may exhaust me instead. Whenever I exhaust, your opponent loses 1 health.

proud-child.name: Proud Child
proud-child.effect:
Whenever you play a card, I deal 1 damage to your oppponent. If you have 3 or less cards in hand, I Distort / 
Exhaust: Both players put the top card of their deck into their scrapyard.

scribe-of-igon.name: Scribe of Igon
scribe-of-igon.effect: Whenever I Distort, your opponent creates a Hazed Memory. If your opponent plays 2 cards in 1 turn, I Distort. / Whenever I Distort, your opponent loses 2 health. If your opponent wields 3 or more armaments, I Distort.

unsettling-prescence.name: Unsettling Prescence
unsettling-prescence.effect:
Sacrifice. When I break, I Distort instead. /
 At your recovery, gain 3 Dread.

wisp-of-remembrance.name: Wisp of Remembrance
wisp-of-remembrance.effect: Sacrifice. Half Moon: As long as your opponent wields a Hazed Memory, I cannot break or lose health.

hunt-untruth.name: Hunt Untruth
hunt-untruth.effect: Whenever an armament you wield distorts, Draw 1. Then you may discard 1. If you don't, break this and put the top 2 cards of your deck into your scrapyard.

frayed-recollection.name: Frayed Recollection
frayed-recollection.effect: You may look at the top card of your deck at any time. You may play cards from the top of your deck. If you play a card with Distort this way, it Distorts when it enters your armoury.

spreading-distortion.name: Spreading Distortion
spreading-distortion.effect: Whenever an armament you wield Distorts, your opponent may put the top card of their deck into their scrapyard. If they don't, your opponent loses 1 life instead.

grasp-at-truth.name: Grasp At Truth
grasp-at-truth.effect: Whenever an armament you wield Distorts, Scavenge a card with the same name. If you don't, lose 2 health. Eclipse: You can only play cards with Distort.

erroneous-slaughter.name: Erroneous Slaughter
erroneous-slaughter.effect: At your recovery, your opponent creates 2 Hazed Memories. Full Moon: Hazed Memories your opponent wield cannot be broken.

thoughts-collapse.name: Thoughts Collapse
thoughts-collapse.effect: At you recovery, Distort any number of armaments you wield. For each one not distorted this way put the top 2 cards of your deck into your scrapyard.

pale-disruption.name: Pale Disruption
pale-disruption.effect: Break an armament your opponent wields that entered their armoury this turn.

existential-dread.name: Existential Dread
existential-dread.effect: Distort an armament you wield. It cannot break or shatter this turn.

memories-washed.name: Memories Washed
memories-washed.effect: Break 2 armaments your opponent wields. Half Moon: Break all armaments instead.

igon-s-oath-sigil.name: Igon's Oath Sigil
igon-s-oath-sigil.effect: Gain 1 resolve this turn. Distort an armament you wield.

igon-s-timepiece.name: Igon's Timepiece
igon-s-timepiece.effect: Draw 1 and discard 1. You may play this from your scrapyard if an armament you wield distorted this turn.

fragments-of-being.name: Fragments of Being
fragments-of-being.effect: Play up to 4 armaments with Distort from your scrapyard without testing resolve. Then Shatter your hand.

reality-dissolves.name: Reality Dissolves
reality-dissolves.effect: Distort an armamnent you wield. Crescent Moon: If that armament was a weapon give it +1 attack as well.

everything-all-at-once.name: Everything All At Once
everything-all-at-once.effect: Your opponent creates a Hazed Memory. If you are Thriving, draw 1 as well.

clairvoyance-in-chaos.name: Clairvoyance In Chaos
clairvoyance-in-chaos.effect: Your opponent creates 5 Hazed Memories. Put the top 10 cards of your deck into your scrapyard. Full Moon: Put the top 2 cards of your deck into your scrapyard instead.

shape-of-memory.name: Shape of Memory
shape-of-memory.effect: Draw 1. You may Distort an armament you wield. If you do, draw 3 instead. Crescent Moon: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them on the top or bottom of your deck in any order first.

temporary-judgement.name: Temporary Judgement
temporary-judgement.effect: Shatter an armament your opponent wields. Return it to their armoury at their next recovery.

leaking-possibility.name: Leaking Possibility
leaking-possibility.effect: Distort an armament you wield. At your recovery, Distort it again. Crescent Moon: Look at the top 3 cards instead and put them back in any order.

distortion-empowerment.name: Distortion Empowerment
distortion-empowerment.effect: Give an armament that Distorted this turn +3 Attack.

correction.name: Correction
correction.effect: Shatter all armaments your opponent wields.

hazed-memory.name: Hazed Memory
hazed-memory.effect: Test 1 Resolve: Break me. You take an additional damage from your opponent.

edge-of-consciousness.name: Edge of Consciousness
edge-of-consciousness.effect: On Attack: Distort all armaments you wield. For each one Distorted this way, I gain +2 attack this turn. Full Moon: Gain +5 Attack instead.

glory.name: Glory
glory.effect: On Strike: If you opponent has 3 or more health, I Distort.

murmuring-deja-vu.name: Murmuring Deja Vu
murmuring-deja-vu.effect: Brandish: Distort an armament you wield. Crescent Moon: On Strike: Draw 1.

bow-of-igon.name: Bow of Igon
bow-of-igon.effect: Lose 1 Temper: Deal 1 Damage to your opponent and all acolytes they wield then I Distort. / On Strike: I lose 1 attack permanently.

infinite-epochs.name: Infinite Epochs
infinite-epochs.effect: At your preparation, if I am in your scrapyard, put me into your armoury, then I Distort.

unstable-glaive.name: Unstable Glaive
unstable-glaive.effect: Brandish: Draw 2 and your opponent creates a Hazed Memory. Half Moon: Your opponent creates 3 Hazed Memories instead.

gauntlet-of-thought.name: Gauntlet of Thought
gauntlet-of-thought.effect: On Strike: Draw 1 and then I Distort

oozing-dagger.name: Oozing Dagger
oozing-dagger.effect: On Strike: Break an armament that tests resolve equal to the damage I dealt. If your opponent is desperate, break any armament instead.

blade-of-abberation.name: Blade of Abberation
blade-of-abberation.effect: On Strike:  Your opponent creates a Hazed Memory. If your opponent wields 2 or less Hazed Memories I Distort.

bow-of-every-possibility.name: Bow of Every Possibility
bow-of-every-possibility.effect: Brandish: Distort all armaments you wield. At your recovery, Distort all armaments that you Distorted this way.

pallbearer.name: Pallbearer
pallbearer.effect: Your health cannot be reduced below 1 as long as this is exhausted. You take double damage if this is Roused.

blood-is-a-reminder.name: Blood Is A Reminder
blood-is-a-reminder.effect: Exhaust: Lose 1 health and Draw 1. Break this. Crescent Moon: Lose 1 health and Draw 2 instead.

make-it-quick.name: Make It Quick
make-it-quick.effect: Whenever your Show Mercy, gain 2 mercy stacks instead. At your recovery, if you do not Show Mercy, lose 2 health.

regret.name: Regret
regret.effect: Whenever you deal damage to your opponent, if you dealt 3 or less damage, prevent that damage and Show Mercy.

personal-creed.name: Personal Creed
personal-creed.effect: Your Mercy gives 1 additional damage. You cannot have more than 5 Mercy. If you have no Mercy, break this.

beg-for-forgiveness.name: Beg for Forgiveness
beg-for-forgiveness.effect: Whenever a player's condition worsens, draw 2 cards and lose 2 health and break this.

remember-the-dead.name: Remember the Dead
remember-the-dead.effect: Exhaust: Give a weapon you wield +X this turn where X is equal to the number of Acolytes in your opponents scrapyard.

sacred-ichor.name: Sacred Ichor
sacred-ichor.effect: The first time you lose health each turn, create 2 Sacred Blood's. At your recovery, if you wield no Sacred Bloods, break this.

name.name: Suffer So That No One Else Does

suffer-so-that-no-one-else-does.name: Suffer So That No One Else Does
suffer-so-that-no-one-else-does.effect: Cards you play cost health instead of testing resolve.

earned-your-rest.name: Earned Your Rest
earned-your-rest.effect: Break an acolyte your opponent wields. Half Moon: Break all Acolytes your opponent wields instead.

iron-will.name: Iron Will
iron-will.effect: Your health cannot be reduced below 1 this turn. Eclipse: This cannot be played.

laced-in-pity.name: Laced in Pity
laced-in-pity.effect: Restore X health where X is equal to your Mercy.

hope-in-blood.name: Hope in Blood
hope-in-blood.effect: Create 4 Sacred Blood. Full Moon: For the rest of the game your Sacred Blood restore 3 health instead.

yandari-s-oath-sigil.name: Yandari's Oath Sigil
yandari-s-oath-sigil.effect: Gain 1 resolve this turn. Show Mercy.

prick-of-sacrifice.name: Prick of Sacrifice
prick-of-sacrifice.effect: Lose 1 health and draw 1. Crescent Moon: Draw 2 and discard 1 instead.

savour-pain.name: Savour Pain
savour-pain.effect: Lose 2 health and create a “Sacred Blood”. Full Moon: Create 4 Sacred Bloods instead.

relinquish.name: Relinquish
relinquish.effect: Lose 2 health and break an armament that tests 2 or less resolve. Half Moon: Break any armament instead.

symbol-of-yandari.name: Symbol of Yandari
symbol-of-yandari.effect: Show Mercy X times where X is equal to the attack of a weapon you wield. Crescent Moon: Repeat this effect.

necessary-pain.name: Necessary Pain
necessary-pain.effect: Give a weapon you wield +1 attack. If you have lost 3 or more health this turn, give a weapon you wield +3 attack instead.

call-of-blood.name: Call of Blood
call-of-blood.effect: If you lost 2 or more health this turn, give a weapon you wield +1 temper. Crescent Moon: Give a weapon you wield +1 attack as well.

memento-mori.name: Memento Mori
memento-mori.effect: Lose 1 health. If your condition is worse than your opponent, draw 2. Crescent Moon: Draw 2 regardless.

end-suffering.name: End Suffering
end-suffering.effect: Break an acolyte your opponent wields. If you lost 5 or more health this turn, break all armaments your opponent wields instead.

goad-death.name: Goad Death
goad-death.effect: Lose 3 health and draw 3. Half Moon: Lose 4 health, and draw 4 instead.

bloody-tribute.name: Bloody Tribute
bloody-tribute.effect: Your weapons deal double damage this turn. After a weapon strikes this turn, shatter it and lose 2 health.

a-better-death.name: A Better Death
a-better-death.effect: Break all acolytes your opponent wields. Give a weapon +X attack where X is equal to the number of Acolytes broken this way.

sacred-blood.name: Sacred Blood
sacred-blood.effect: Exhaust: Restore 2 health and break this.

promise.name: Promise
promise.effect: On Strike: If I dealt 3 or more damage, draw 1.

undying-oath.name: Undying Oath
undying-oath.effect: Whenever I would lose Temper, you may lose 2 health instead.

life.name: Life
life.effect: Brandish: If you do not wield “Death”, you may play it from your hand without testing resolve. If you do, lose 3 health.

rest.name: Rest
rest.effect: On Strike: Break an acolyte your opponent wields that tests X resolve, where X is equal to the damage I dealt.

death.name: Death
death.effect: If you are desperate, I have +3 attack.

liberation.name: Liberation
liberation.effect: At your recovery, if this is Roused, Show Mercy.

uldes-atonement.name: Uldes' Atonement
uldes-atonement.effect: At your recovery, if you lost 3 or more health this turn, this gains +1 attack and +1 Temper.

thirsting-steel.name: Thirsting Steel
thirsting-steel.effect: On Attack: Mercy is not consumed this turn. Lose 1 health for each Mercy you have.

mourning-glory.name: Mourning Glory
mourning-glory.effect: On Strike: If this dealt 8 or more damage, Rouse this and lose half your health. Eclipse: I must attack each turn if able.

worship.name: Worship
worship.effect: This has +X attack where X is equal to your opponents health. When this breaks, you lose the game.

bleeding-boulder.name: Bleeding Boulder
bleeding-boulder.effect: Graft 5. On Attack: Create a Parasitic Pebble. Eclipse: Parasitic Pebbles grant +0 instead.

jin-blazing-serpent.name: Jin, Blazing Serpent
jin-blazing-serpent.effect: Graft 2. On Strike: Deal 2 damage. Crescent Moon: On Strike: Witness Feng, Tempest Serpent.

feng-tempest-serpent.name: Feng, Tempest Serpent
feng-tempest-serpent.effect: Graft 2. On Strike: Draw 1. Crescent Moon: On Strike: Witness Jin, Blazing Serpent.

dread-breeze.name: Dread Breeze
dread-breeze.effect: Graft 1. When this grafts, put the top card of your deck into your scrapyard. As long as this is grafted, whenever you would restore health, prevent that restoration instead.

turbulent-ember.name: Turbulent Ember
turbulent-ember.effect: Graft 0.  On Strike: Break me and deal 1 damage.

cornered-mountain.name: Cornered Mountain
cornered-mountain.effect: Graft 9. On Attack: Gain +1 Attack and +1 Temper.

it-that-heralds-ruin.name: It That Heralds Ruin
it-that-heralds-ruin.effect: Graft 3. On Strike: Break all armaments your opponent wields.

endless-slate.name: Endless Slate
endless-slate.effect: Graft 2. Sacrifice.  This enters exhausted. When this breaks, return this to your hand instead.

the-flame-that-devours.name: The Flame That Devours
the-flame-that-devours.effect: Graft 3. At your recovery, Deal X damage to your opponent where X is equal to my attack.

stillwater.name: Stillwater
stillwater.effect: Graft 1. As long as this is exhausted, your opponent cannot rouse 1 resolve during their preparation.

boiling-rain.name: Boiling Rain
boiling-rain.effect: Graft 2. On Strike: This turn, your resolve gain "Exhaust: Deal 1 damage".

cacophony-of-fauna.name: Cacophony of Fauna
cacophony-of-fauna.effect: Your cards test 1 less resolve for each grafted armament you wield. Whenever you play a card, break an acolyte you wield.

cowering-roots.name: Cowering Roots
cowering-roots.effect: Whenever you play a weapon, You may Graft an ungrafted acolyte you wield to it without resting resolve. At your preparation, if you do not wield a weapon, break this and put the top 5 cards of your deck into your scrapyard.

gro-s-conviction.name: Gro's Conviction
gro-s-conviction.effect: Whenever you Graft to a weapon you wield, you may give that weapon +1 temper. If you do, break me.

leeching-elements.name: Leeching Elements
leeching-elements.effect: At your recovery, if you wield a grafted weapon, draw 1. Crescent Moon: This cannot break.

anointed-host.name: Anointed Host
anointed-host.effect: Return up to 2 acolytes from your scrapyard to your hand.

embrace-the-elements.name: Embrace the Elements
embrace-the-elements.effect: Restore X health, where X is equal to the number of acolytes you wield.

kuranic-rebirth.name: Kuranic Rebirth
kuranic-rebirth.effect: Return a weapon or acolyte from your scrapyard to your hand.

unwavered-verdance.name: Unwavered Verdance
unwavered-verdance.effect: Choose a grafted armament. It cannot be broken this turn. Crescent Moon: This tests 1 less resolve.

devoured-nature.name: Devoured Nature
devoured-nature.effect: If you wield a weapon with 3 or more grafts attached, break an armament. Full Moon: Break all armaments your opponent wields instead.

kuran-s-oath-sigil.name: Kuran's Oath Sigil
kuran-s-oath-sigil.effect: Gain 1 resolve this turn only. Witness an Acolyte with Graft.

omen-fruit.name: Omen Fruit
omen-fruit.effect: You may play an Acolyte from your hand without testing resolve, if you do, Graft it to weapon you wield.

burning-adaptation.name: Burning Adaptation
burning-adaptation.effect: Give a weapon +1 For each graft attached to it. Half Moon: Then doublt it's attack this turn.

palesoaked-petal.name: Palesoaked Petal
palesoaked-petal.effect: Crescent Moon: Restore 3 Health. Half Moon: Witness an Acolyte. Full Moon: Restore 5 Health and return an Acolyte from your scrapyard to your hand.

encroaching-stampede.name: Encroaching Stampede
encroaching-stampede.effect: Witness an Acolyte that tests 2 or less resolve. Eclipse: Your opponent may do the same.

a-tainted-rumble.name: A Tainted Rumble
a-tainted-rumble.effect: The next time a grafted weapon you wield strikes this turn, deal damage equal to the number of grafts attached to it.

melded-soul.name: Melded Soul
melded-soul.effect: Graft an acolyte to a weapon you wield without testing resolve. Half Moon: Give it +1 Temper as well.

elemental-outburst.name: Elemental Outburst
elemental-outburst.effect: Witness up to 2 weapons or acolytes that test a total of 4 or less resolve and play them.

dissonant-wilderness.name: Dissonant Wilderness
dissonant-wilderness.effect: Give a weapon you wield the attack of all acolytes grafted to it, then break all Acolytes Grafted to it.

parasitic-pebble.name: Parasitic Pebble
parasitic-pebble.effect: Graft 2. This is permanently exhausted. Your weapons have +1 attack.

one-s-self.name: One's Self
one-s-self.effect: This cannot be removed from your armoury. On Strike: Gain +1 Temper.

kreena-s-staff-of-connection.name: Kreena's Staff of Connection
kreena-s-staff-of-connection.effect: Whenever an Acolyte is grafted to me, Rouse me. Crescent Moon: Grafting to me tests 1 less resolve.

amalgamation.name: Amalgamation
amalgamation.effect: I have the attack of all acolytes grafted to me.

haven.name: Haven
haven.effect: At your preparation and recovery, if I am not grafted, graft an acolyte you wield to me without testing resolve.

ashen-wood-bow.name: Ashen Wood Bow
ashen-wood-bow.effect: Lose 1 Temper: Deal 1 damage (this counts as striking). Half Moon: I deal 2 damage instead.

lashing-vines.name: Lashing Vines
lashing-vines.effect: On Strike: Deal 1 damage for every graft attached to this. Whenever this would lose temper, you may break an acolyte grafted to this instead.

menagerie.name: Menagerie
menagerie.effect: This has +1 Attack for each acolyte grafted to this.

cadaver-bloom.name: Cadaver Bloom
cadaver-bloom.effect: You may Graft acolytes from the scrapyard to this.

budding-blade.name: Budding Blade
budding-blade.effect: Brandish: Graft an Acolyte you wield to this.

thrill-seeker.name: Thrill Seeker
thrill-seeker.effect: On Strike: Lose 1 health and Rouse this.

endless-hedonists.name: Endless Hedonists
endless-hedonists.effect: If you are thriving, my health cannot reduce below 0.

existential-gambler.name: Existential Gambler
existential-gambler.effect: Whenever you draw, draw an additional 1 card and this loses 1 health. When this breaks create 1 Apathy.

pain-enjoyer.name: Pain Enjoyer
pain-enjoyer.effect: Sacrifice. Half Moon: I can only lose 1 health at a time.

lecherous-pair.name: Lecherous Pair
lecherous-pair.effect: On Attack: Both players lose 1 health.

lil-finch.name: Lil Finch
lil-finch.effect: Brandish: Draw 1. On Strike: Deal 1 damage. Then you may discard 1 card, if you don't create 1 insignificance.

masochist.name: Masochist
masochist.effect: On Attack: Draw 1. Then you may have your opponent draw 1 as well. If you don't, create 1 Loneliness.

exhiliration.name: Exhiliration
exhiliration.effect: The first time an acolyte you wield attacks each turn, you may Indulge. If you do, lose 1 health and Rouse it. If you don't, create 1 Apathy.

lust.name: Lust
lust.effect: Brandish: Choose an acolyte you wield. At your preparation, the chosen acolyte gains +1 attack and you put the top card of your deck into your scrapyard. When this breaks, create 1 Loneliness.

pleasure-seeker.name: Pleasure Seeker
pleasure-seeker.effect: On Strike: Your opponent cannot play ripostes this turn. Crescent Moon: I enter ready.

exhillerated-brawler.name: Exhillerated Brawler
exhillerated-brawler.effect: On Attack: Gain +1 Attack this turn. Then you may put the top 1 card(s) of your deck into your scrapyard. If you don't create 1 Apathy.

greed.name: Greed
greed.effect: The first time an acolyte you wield attacks, draw 1. If you would draw a card while your hand is full, put that card into your scrapyard instead and create 1 Insignificance.

comforter.name: Comforter
comforter.effect: Sacrifice. If an acolyte you wield would break, you may break this instead. Full Moon: Your opponent cannot target acolytes you wield.

decadence.name: Decadence
decadence.effect: As long as you wield this, your resolve have "Test: Indulge". When this breaks create 1 Despair.

give-in-to-temptation.name: Give In to Temptation
give-in-to-temptation.effect: At your preparation Indulge. If you put indulgence counters on 3 or less armaments you wield, break this. Crescent Moon: Put an extra indulgence counter on 1 of your armanents.

blind-indulgence.name: Blind Indulgence
blind-indulgence.effect: At your preapration, you may Indulge 1 time. If you don't break this and create 1 Despair, Apathy, Lonliness, and Insignicance.

demand-of-luxury.name: Demand of Luxury
demand-of-luxury.effect: At your preparation draw 1 and put the top card of your deck into your scrapyard. Then if your scrapyard has 15 or more cards in it, break this and create 1 Insiginifcance.

bloody-desires.name: Bloody Desires
bloody-desires.effect: Your acolytes can attack your opponent directly. If they do, they lose 1 health. If an acolyte you wield breaks, break this.

kiss-stained-handkerchief.name: Kiss Stained Handkerchief
kiss-stained-handkerchief.effect: Choose an acolyte you wield, your opponent must attack it this turn.

seduction.name: Seduction
seduction.effect: Weapons your opponent wields cannot be exhausted this turn. Indulge. Eclipse: This cannot be played.

numb.name: Numb
numb.effect: Acolytes you wield with 3 or more indulgence counters on them cannot be broken this turn.

worth-its-weight.name: Worth Its Weight
worth-its-weight.effect: Break an armament your opponent wields. Draw X cards where X is half the broken armament's resolve. Half Moon: X is equal to the max resolve instead.

niorr-s-oath-sigil.name: Niorr's Oath Sigil
niorr-s-oath-sigil.effect: Gain 1 resolve this turn and Indulge.

dissonant-dice.name: Dissonant Dice
dissonant-dice.effect: Draw 1, discard 1, and Indulge. Crescent Moon: Draw 2 discard 2 at random.

murmurs-of-aggression.name: Murmurs of Aggression
murmurs-of-aggression.effect: Give an acolyte you wield +2 Attack. Full Moon: Give an acolyte +5 Attack instead.

do-it.name: Do it
do-it.effect: Indulge. Full Moon: Indulge 3 times instead and put the top 5 cards of your deck into your scrapyard.

craving-senesation.name: Craving Senesation
craving-senesation.effect: Ready all acolytes you wield and give them +1 attack this turn for each indulgence counter on them.

strange-affection.name: Strange Affection
strange-affection.effect: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is an Acolyte that tests 3 or less resolve, you may play it without testing resolve. Otherwise, your opponent draws 1.

unbound-craving.name: Unbound Craving
unbound-craving.effect: Break a weapon your opponent wields that tests less than 2 resolve. Half Moon: Break any weapon instead.

nothing-to-live-for.name: Nothing To Live For
nothing-to-live-for.effect: Deal 1 damage to your opponent. Repeat this for each withdrawal you wield. Put the top 2 cards of your deck into your scrapyard for each damage dealt this way.

toxic-intimacy.name: Toxic Intimacy
toxic-intimacy.effect: Your opponent draws 2 cards and loses 2 health.

gleeful-wrath.name: Gleeful Wrath
gleeful-wrath.effect: On Attack: I copy the attack of an acolyte you wield.

glistening.name: Glistening
glistening.effect: On Attack: Draw 1. Then you may put the top 1 card of your deck into your scrapyard. If you don't, create a Insignificance.

whispering-gold.name: Whispering Gold
whispering-gold.effect: On Attack: I gain +1 Attack this turn. When this breaks draw 1 card and create 1 random withdrawal.

addiction.name: Addiction
addiction.effect: I have +1 Attack for each armament you wield with an indulgence counter on it. I do not gain effects from Indulgence counters.

bloodied-knuckles.name: Bloodied Knuckles
bloodied-knuckles.effect: Whenever I kill an acolyte, I gain +2 Attack. Crescent Moon: I gain +3 Attack instead.

velvet-chain.name: Velvet Chain
velvet-chain.effect: On Attack: Indulge. Your Opponent may draw 1.

pleasure-lash.name: Pleasure Lash
pleasure-lash.effect: Whenever your opponent plays a card, I gain +1 attack.

staff-of-craving.name: Staff of Craving
staff-of-craving.effect: On Strike: If you have 8 or more cards in hand, I have +3 Attack and cannot lose Temper this turn. If you have an empty hand, break me and create 1 Insignificance.

apathy.name: Apathy
apathy.effect: At the start of your turn give a weapon you wield -1 Attack.

loneliness.name: Loneliness
loneliness.effect: At your preparation break an acolyte you wield.

insignificance.name: Insignificance
insignificance.effect: The first time you take damage each turn, you take 1 additional damage.

despair.name: Despair
despair.effect: Your resolve maximum is reduced by 1.

essence-carver.name: Essence Carver
essence-carver.effect: If you wield 2 or more exhausted Tomes, this has +2.

budding-romance.name: Budding Romance
budding-romance.effect: Strike: Your opponent creates a "Love Letter" and disarm this.

jireth-s-burning-hatred.name: Jireth's Burning Hatred
jireth-s-burning-hatred.effect: Attack: Deal 1 damage. If you are Jireth, repeat this. Eclipse: This restores health instead.

taviq-s-staff.name: Taviq's Staff
taviq-s-staff.effect: Attack: Cast a spell from an exhausted tome you wield. If you are Taviq, this does not drain essence.

vengeful-ichor.name: Vengeful Ichor
vengeful-ichor.effect: Attack: If you are Hateful, your next tactic tests 1 less resolve. Crescent Moon: This inflicts Poison.

drain-emotion.name: Drain Emotion
drain-emotion.effect: At preparation, if you triggered love or hate 2 or more times since your last preparation, your opponent loses 1 health, then channel Love or Hate. (Become Loving or Hateful. For the remainder of the turn whenever you whenever you play a card, If you are Loving restore 1 health. If you are Hateful deal 1 damage).

esoteric-whispers.name: Esoteric Whispers
esoteric-whispers.effect: The first time you cast a spell each turn, draw 1.

hollow-love.name: Hollow Love
hollow-love.effect: Whenever your opponent would restore health during your turn, they lose 1 health instead.

body-given.name: Body Given
body-given.effect: You are always Loving. At preparation, your opponent restores 1 health. Crescent Moon: Repeat this.

nourishing-devotion.name: Nourishing Devotion
nourishing-devotion.effect: After exhausting a Tome, discard 1 at random. If you are Loving, you may cast 2 spells from that tome. If you are Hateful, your next tactic tests 2 less resolve.

qirune-s-gift-to-her-child.name: Qirune's Gift to Her Child
qirune-s-gift-to-her-child.effect: Gain 10 resolve this turn. Hateful and Loving effects are doubled this turn. At your recovery, if you did not play 5 or more cards this turn, you lose the game.

tome-of-qirune.name: Tome of Qirune
tome-of-qirune.effect:
3 Essence. You must use this every turn. When this breaks, you lose the game.
Sun - Draw 5. Gain 4 resolve this turn.
Moon - Your opponent scraps 5.
Stars -  Show Mercy, Fight Dirty, Divine, Channel, Evolve, Breathe.

blackened-page.name: Blackened Page
blackened-page.effect: Use: Deal 2 damage and draw 1. Channel Hate. Half Moon: Dead 4 damage, draw 2 and lose 2 health.

etchings-of-qirune.name: Etchings of Qirune
etchings-of-qirune.effect: Use: Play a tome from the scrapyard. It has 1 essensce.

offering.name: Offering
offering.effect: This enters exhausted. Use: Create a “Gift of Qirune” or "Charm" and draw 1.

qirunes-s-charm-of-hope.name: Qirunes's Charm of Hope
qirunes-s-charm-of-hope.effect: Use: Both players draw 1. If you are Loving, you Witness as well. Crescent Moon: Channel Love first. (Become Loving and for the remainder of the turn whenever you play a card, restore 1 health).

bubble-of-hope.name: Bubble of Hope
bubble-of-hope.effect: Gain 3 guard. At your next preparation, Channel Love. (Become Loving and for the remainder of the turn whenever you play a card, restore 1 health).

toxic-positivity.name: Toxic Positivity
toxic-positivity.effect: If you are loving, inflict poison.

magician-s-love.name: Magician's Love
magician-s-love.effect: Recover your condition. At your recovery, reduce your health to 1. Full Moon: Do not reduce your health to 1.

hatred.name: Hatred
hatred.effect: Deal 1 damage. If you are Hateful, Your next tactic tests1 less resolve.

how-dare-you.name: How Dare You
how-dare-you.effect: Channel Hate. (Become Hateful and for the remainder of the turn whenever you play a card, deal 1 damage). You may play a card that tests 1 or less resolve or draw 1.

illusions-of-peace.name: Illusions of Peace
illusions-of-peace.effect: Gain 4 guard. Then you may cast a spell from a Tome you wield without exhausting it or draining essence.

emotional-mending.name: Emotional Mending
emotional-mending.effect: Cure all of your ailments and Channel Love. (Become Loving and for the remainder of the turn whenever you play a card, restore 1 health). Half Moon: Both players return a card from the scrapyard to their hand.

emotional-overload.name: Emotional Overload
emotional-overload.effect: Deal damage equal to the amount of health you restored this turn. Discard 2. Then, if you are loving, both players gain 2 guard.

gentle-warning.name: Gentle Warning
gentle-warning.effect: Disarm an armament that tests 2 or less resolve. If you are Loving, both players draw 1 or restore 1 health.

her-magic-empowers-me.name: Her Magic Empowers Me
her-magic-empowers-me.effect: Cast a spell from an exhausted Tome you wield or break a Tome you wield and give a weapon you wield +2.

hex.name: Hex
hex.effect: If you are Hateful, draw 1. Otherwise, Channel Hate. (Become Hateful and for the remainder of the turn whenever you play a card, deal 1 damage). Half Moon: This tests 0 resolve to play.

joyous-return.name: Joyous Return
joyous-return.effect: Play an armament from the scrapyard that tests 2 or less resolve. If you are Loving, both players restore 2 health. Crescent Moon: Play an armament that tests 3 or less resolve instead.

misery-loves-company.name: Misery Loves Company
misery-loves-company.effect: Until your next recovery, whenever you deal damage with Hate, deal 1 additional damage. Crescent Moon: This tests 1 less resolve.

painful-memories.name: Painful Memories
painful-memories.effect: The next tactic you play this turn tests 2 less resolve. Draw 1. If you are hateful, draw 2. Crescent Moon: Channel Hate First. (Become Hateful and for the remainder of the turn whenever you play a card, deal 1 damage).

playful-mood.name: Playful Mood
playful-mood.effect: Disarm an armament your opponent wields that tests 3 or less resolve. If you are loving, both players draw 1.

rage.name: Rage
rage.effect: Deal 2 damage. If you are hateful, your next tactic you play this turn tests 2 less resolve . Full Moon: This tests 2 less resolve.

shadows-of-magic.name: Shadows of Magic
shadows-of-magic.effect: Deal 1 damage. Repeat this for each time you have dealt damage with Hate this turn. Crescent Moon: Deal 2 damage.

two-sides-of-qirune.name: Two Sides of Qirune
two-sides-of-qirune.effect: Draw 1. If you are Loving, restore 1 health. If you are Hateful, deal 1 damage.

charm.name: Charm
charm.effect: Use: Witness. If you are Loving, both players also restore 1 health.

gift-of-qirune.name: Gift of Qirune
gift-of-qirune.effect: Use: Channel Love or Hate. If you are already loving or hateful, using this counts as playing a card.

hardened-essence.name: Hardened Essence
hardened-essence.effect: Use: Your next tactic tests 1 less resolve or both players draw 1.

hollow-feeling.name: Hollow Feeling
hollow-feeling.effect: Use: You cannot be loving or hateful this turn.

love-letter.name: Love Letter
love-letter.effect: Use: Both players draw 1 or restore 1 health. Your opponent creates a "Love Letter".

seething-hate.name: Seething Hate
seething-hate.effect: Use: Tactics you play this turn test 1 less resolve. Lose 2 health.

tome-of-anger.name: Tome of Anger
tome-of-anger.effect:
3 Essence.
Forge - Create a “Hardened Essence”. Discard 2.
Raze - Break a weapon and lose 3 health.
Mold - Create a copy of a weapon you wield. Break all non weapon armaments you wield.

tome-of-benevolence.name: Tome of Benevolence
tome-of-benevolence.effect:
1 Essence. If you are Loving, after casting a spell from this, draw 2.
Euphoria - Restore 5 health to both players.
Divine Protection - Both players gain 5 GUARD.

tome-of-greed.name: Tome of Greed
tome-of-greed.effect:
2 Essence. Full Moon: Brandish: This gains +3 Essence.
Swallow - Your opponent loses 1 health and you restore 1 health. 
Spit -  Deal 1 damage for each health restored this turn.

tome-of-joy.name: Tome of Joy
tome-of-joy.effect:
2 Essence. Half Moon: Whenever you cast a spell from this, restore 2 health.
Relax - Cure an ailment.
Dream - Witness

tome-of-loathing.name: Tome of Loathing
tome-of-loathing.effect:
2 Essence. If you are Hateful, this Tome’s spell cast twice and you discard 2.
Abhorrent Thoughts - Your opponent loses 1 health for every ailment they are afflicted with.  Eclipse: Cure all ailments.
Malice - The next time you deal damage with Hate, inflict an ailment. Eclipse: The next time you deal damage with hate restore that much health instead.

tome-of-mischief.name: Tome of Mischief
tome-of-mischief.effect:
2 Essence.
Hide -  You cannot be attacked until your next preparation.
Seek - Draw 1 and discard 1.

tome-of-serenity.name: Tome of Serenity
tome-of-serenity.effect:
2 Essence.
Dirt - Gain 2 GUARD. Eclipse: Break your opponents guard.
Hearth - Create an “Ember”. Eclipse: Create a "Hollow Feeling"
Breeze - Disarm an armament that tests 2 or less resolve. Eclipse: Lose 2 health.

tome-of-encumbering-love.name: Tome of Encumbering Love
tome-of-encumbering-love.effect:
2 Essence.
Courtship - Restore 2 health to your opponent. 
Offering - Your opponents next card tests 1 less resolve.
Devotion - Your opponent draws 1. 
If you have cast 20 or more spells from this, You win the game.

claws-to-tear.name: Claws to Tear
claws-to-tear.effect: Attack: If this has 3 or more mutation counters on it, this inflicts Bleed.

oozing-point.name: Oozing Point
oozing-point.effect: Attack: If this has 3 or more Mutation counters, this also inflicts Poison.

automatic-brewer.name: Automatic Brewer
automatic-brewer.effect: Brandish: Shatter a concoction you wield. Attack: Repeat the effect of the concoction shattered by this.

evolution-s-peak.name: Evolution's Peak
evolution-s-peak.effect: If this has 5 or more mutation counters on it, this gains +5 and "Strike: Break an armament and your opponent scraps 5". At your recovery, if this has 4 or less mutation counters on it, lose 5 health.

reactive-mutation.name: Reactive Mutation
reactive-mutation.effect: After you use a concoction. This has +X where X is equal to the dice result this turn. If you roll a 6, break this and lose 5 health. If this has 5 or more mutation counters on it, you dice result cannot be less than 3.

become-perfect.name: Become Perfect
become-perfect.effect: After you Evolve, if this has 20 or more mutation counters on it, you win the game.

coated-skin.name: Coated Skin
coated-skin.effect: Test 3 Resolve: Evolve. If your opponent deals attack damage to you and this has 3 or more mutation counters on it, inflict your opponent with a random ailment.

bone-extension-defensive.name: Bone Extension: Defensive
bone-extension-defensive.effect: At your preparation gain 1 guard and scrap 1. This effect is increased by 1 for each armament you wield with a mutation counter.

skin-like-steel.name: Skin Like Steel
skin-like-steel.effect: After you Evolve, gain 2 guard and discard 1. If this has 3 or more mutation counters, this cannot be broken as long as you have guard.

made-for-this.name: Made For This
made-for-this.effect: At your preparation if you wield an armament without a mutation counter on it, Evolve.

self-testing.name: Self Testing
self-testing.effect: The first time you use a concoction each turn, you may lose health equal to the dice result. If you do, roll again. If this has 3 or more mutation counters on it, you may repeat this 1 additional time.

victim-of-science.name: Victim of Science
victim-of-science.effect: After you use a concoction, you may discard 1 at random. If you do, Evolve twice. If this has 2 or more mutations counters on it, do not discard at random.

zyxa-s-presence.name: Zyxa's Presence
zyxa-s-presence.effect: After you Evolve, Break an armament that tests X resolve where X is equal to the number of mutation counters on this. If you are Zyxa, armaments you wield with 4 or more mutation counters on them can't be disarmed or broken.

killer-instinct.name: Killer Instinct
killer-instinct.effect: Evolve 10 times. Then if you wield a weapon with 15 or more mutation counters on it give it +10 and "When I break you lose the game".

xurdos-gift-of-ambition.name: Xurdos' Gift of Ambition
xurdos-gift-of-ambition.effect: Brandish: Play all concoctions from the scrapyard.  You may wield any number of concoctions. At recovery, if you did not use at least 3 concoctions, you lose the game.

bubbling-brew.name: Bubbling Brew
bubbling-brew.effect:
Use: Roll a dice and inflict: Half Moon: Repeat this.
1-2: Poison.
3-4: Bleed
5-6: Fear

crystalised-veil-potion.name: Crystalised Veil Potion
crystalised-veil-potion.effect:
Use: Roll a dice. Crescent Moon: If you roll a 2-5 gain 4 guard instead.
1: Deal 2 damage to yourself
2-5: Gain 3 guard
6: Gain 8 guard it cannot break until your next preparation.

exquiste-moonlight.name: Exquiste Moonlight
exquiste-moonlight.effect:
Use: Roll a dice , lose 2 health and scrap 2. Crescent Moon: Lose 1 and scrap 1 instead.
Choose any number of effects below, equal to the result.
- Give a weapon you wield +2
- Draw 1
- Restore 1 Health
-Evolve

malice-of-the-pale-stare.name: Malice of the Pale Stare
malice-of-the-pale-stare.effect:
Use: Roll a dice. Crescent Moon: If you roll a 2-5 give a weapon you wield +3 instead.
1: You cannot attack for 2 turns.
2-5: Give a weapon you wield +2
6: Your next attack inflicts Bleed 3.

xurdos-s-ichor.name: Xurdos's Ichor
xurdos-s-ichor.effect:
Use: Roll a dice. Crescent Moon: If you roll a 2-5 also cure an ailment.
1: Lose 5 health.
2-5: Restore 3 health
6: Your condition recovers. Set your health to 1.

mimicing-muck.name: Mimicing Muck
mimicing-muck.effect: Use: Roll a dice. Play an armament from the scrapyard that tests X resolve where X is equal to the dice result. Half Moon: Play 2 instead.

pale-miasma.name: Pale Miasma
pale-miasma.effect:
Use: Roll a dice: Half Moon: This tests 2 less resolve to play.
1: Lose 5 health and inflict yourself with Poison. 
2-5: Inflict all ailments on your opponent.
6: Inflict all ailments on your opponent and they lose 3 health.

pale-potion.name: Pale Potion
pale-potion.effect:
Use: Roll a dice. Full Moon: If you roll a 1, roll again.
1: Discard 2.
2-5: Witness a card that tests 3 or less resolve .
6: Draw 3.

potion-of-phases.name: Potion of Phases
potion-of-phases.effect:
Use: Roll a dice. Eclipse: This always rolls 5.
1: Restore 3 health.
2: Gain 2 Resolve this turn.
3: Draw 2 and discard 1.
4: Evolve twice.
5: Lose 3 health.
6: Give a weapon you wield +3.

explosive-ingredient.name: Explosive Ingredient
explosive-ingredient.effect: Use: The next time you use a concoction, if the result is 3 or more  both players create 2 “Puddles”. Otherwise, discard 2 and scrap 2.

illicit-substance.name: Illicit Substance
illicit-substance.effect: Use: The next time you Evolve, Evolve an additional time.

lost-child-s-toy.name: Lost Child's Toy
lost-child-s-toy.effect: Use: Evolve or play a concoction from the scrapyard that tests 2 or less resolve. If this has 5 or more mutation counters, you may play an additional armament from the scrapyard.

potion-belt.name: Potion Belt
potion-belt.effect: Use: Witness a concoction that costs 2 or less. If you don’t, this does not break.

destructive-reaction.name: Destructive Reaction
destructive-reaction.effect: You may play and use a concoction that tests 3 or less resolve. Break an armament that tests X resolve where X is equal to the dice result.

lo-s-mad-science.name: Lo's Mad Science
lo-s-mad-science.effect: Lose 2 health. Play a concoction from the scrapyard without testing resolve. You may repeat this process. If you are Lo, this tests1 less resolve.

progress-to-perfection.name: Progress to Perfection
progress-to-perfection.effect: Evolve. Break an armament you wield that tests X resolve where X is equal to the number of mutation counters on the armament you wield with the most mutation counters.

puddles-everywhere.name: Puddles Everywhere
puddles-everywhere.effect: You and your opponent both create a “Puddle”.

unready-test.name: Unready Test
unready-test.effect: If your opponent is attacking, play a concoction without testing resolve and use it. Give it's result -2.

nothing-can-stop-us.name: Nothing Can Stop Us
nothing-can-stop-us.effect: Break all armaments without mutation counters on them. Discard 2.

adapt-and-survive.name: Adapt and Survive
adapt-and-survive.effect: Evolve. If you have less health than your opponent, Evolve again.

agonizing-progress.name: Agonizing Progress
agonizing-progress.effect: Discard your hand. Evolve for each card discarded this way.

maniacal-testing.name: Maniacal Testing
maniacal-testing.effect: Use all concoctions you wield and disarm them. If you roll a 4 or more this turn, Scrap 2.

personal-development.name: Personal Development
personal-development.effect: Evolve. If you wield an armament with 3 or more mutation counters on it, draw 1.

survival-of-the-fittest.name: Survival of the Fittest
survival-of-the-fittest.effect: Evolve and break an armament that tests 3 or less resolve.

traumatic-rage.name: Traumatic Rage
traumatic-rage.effect: Give a weapon you wield +1 for each mutation counter on it.

vicious-vapour.name: Vicious Vapour
vicious-vapour.effect: Inflict a random ailment for each "Puddle" your opponent wields.

puddle.name: Puddle
puddle.effect:
Test 1 Resolve: Break this.
At each Recovery, repeat a random effect of the last concoction used this turn. If neither player has used a concoction this turn, do nothing. This does not count as using a concoction.

heliana-yade-thriving.name: Heliana Yade
heliana-yade-thriving.effect: Whenever an armament you wield Distorts, your opponent creates a "Hazed Memory"

heliana-yade-wounded.name: Heliana Yade
heliana-yade-wounded.effect: At your preparation If your opponent has 3 or more Hazed Memories, draw 2 and discard 1.

heliana-yade-desperate.name: Heliana Yade
heliana-yade-desperate.effect: On Strike: If your opponent wields 10 or more Hazed Memories, that player loses the game.

pora-aliestrad-thriving.name: Pora Aliestrad
pora-aliestrad-thriving.effect: Whenever an armament you wield would Distort, you may exhaust me instead. At your recovery, if I am exhausted, discard 1.

pora-aliestrad-wounded.name: Pora Aliestrad
pora-aliestrad-wounded.effect: Whenever an armament you wield would Distort, you may test 2 resolve and discard 1. If you do, return it to your hand instead.

pora-aliestrad-desperate.name: Pora Aliestrad
pora-aliestrad-desperate.effect: Whenever an armament you wield would distort, put the top 3 cards of your deck into your scrapyard and your opponent loses 1 health instead.

gro-thriving.name: Gro'
gro-thriving.effect: If your opponent would break a weapon you wield, if it is grafted, you may break an acolyte grafted to it instead.

gro-wounded.name: Gro'
gro-wounded.effect: Weapons you wield cannot be broken as long as they have 3 or more acolytes grafted to it.

gro-desperate.name: Gro'
gro-desperate.effect: You can Graft acolytes to me.

kreena-eldervyre-thriving.name: Kreena Eldervyre
kreena-eldervyre-thriving.effect: Whenever you graft, deal 1 damage to your opponent.

kreena-eldervyre-wounded.name: Kreena Eldervyre
kreena-eldervyre-wounded.effect: Your first graft each turn tests 0 resolve. Whenever you graft, discard 1.

kreena-eldervyre-desperate.name: Kreena Eldervyre
kreena-eldervyre-desperate.effect: At your preparation, Graft all acolytes you wield to a weapon you wield without testing resolve. At your recovery, Shatter that weapon.

shiera-silkthroat-wounded.name: Shiera Silkthroat
shiera-silkthroat-wounded.effect: Acolytes with 2 or more indulgence counters on them can attack your opponent directly.

shiera-silkthroat-desperate.name: Shiera Silkthroat
shiera-silkthroat-desperate.effect: Break an acolyte you wield: Give all Indulgence counters it had to another acolyte you wield.

nine-lives-thriving.name: Nine Lives
nine-lives-thriving.effect: Whenever you indulge, also put a counter on me.

nine-lives-wounded.name: Nine Lives
nine-lives-wounded.effect: At your preparation, draw 1 and put the top 1 card(s) of your deck into your scrapyard.

nine-lives-desperate.name: Nine Lives
nine-lives-desperate.effect: The first time your health is reduced to 0, Set your health to 1 instead.

kakandi-bloodbrood-wounded.name: Kakandi Bloodbrood
kakandi-bloodbrood-wounded.effect: You may spend Mercy to help pay resolve cost of armaments you play.

kakandi-bloodbrood-desperate.name: Kakandi Bloodbrood
kakandi-bloodbrood-desperate.effect: At your prepartion, If your opponent is desperate and your Mercy is equal to your opponent's health,  they lose the game.

uldes-var-thriving.name: Uldes Var
uldes-var-thriving.effect: The first time you lose health during your turn, ready a weapon you wield.

uldes-var-wounded.name: Uldes Var
uldes-var-wounded.effect: Whenever you lose health during your turn, give a weapon you wield +1 attack this turn.

uldes-var-desperate.name: Uldes Var
uldes-var-desperate.effect: As long as you have 3 or less health, all weapons deal double damage.

fleeting-visions.name: Fleeting Visions
fleeting-visions.effect: Each player draws an additional card during their draw phase. At each players recovery, that player discards 1.

pale-glow.name: Pale Glow
pale-glow.effect: Each player's maximum resolve is increased by 1.

death-with-no-meaning.name: Death With No Meaning
death-with-no-meaning.effect: At any time a player may test 3 resolve to return a card from their scrapyard to their hand.

temptation-of-chaos.name: Temptation of Chaos
temptation-of-chaos.effect: All Weapons and Acolytes have +1 Attack.

unraveling.name: Unraveling
unraveling.effect: At the end of each players recovery, all armaments that player wields lose 1 health and 1 Temper.

stinging-madness.name: Stinging Madness
stinging-madness.effect: Whenever a player draws a card outside of their draw phase, they lose 1 health.

overwhelming-dread.name: Overwhelming Dread
overwhelming-dread.effect: All Damage is Dealt as Dread instead.

existential-permanence.name: Existential Permanence
existential-permanence.effect: Whenever an armament is broken, shatter it instead.
